run_server_process: run a vLLM server process with a given command using a context manager that handles startup and cleanup
test_server_ready: test if a vLLM server is ready by polling the /health endpoint within a timeout
reset_server_caches: reset vLLM server caches (prefix, memory, encoder) via HTTP POST endpoints
build_server_context_manager: build a context manager that starts a server subprocess and stops it on exit
review_server_process_class: review the ServerProcess class that manages lifecycle of a benchmark server subprocess
